# Key Findings (auto-generated)

Factual rollup of the current feature dataset. Interpretation lives in the final report.

## Overview
- Posts: 31,677 across 2 platforms (youtube: 27,967, instagram: 3,710).
- Content date range: 2017-05-08 to 2026-08-09.

## Sentiment by platform (English)
- instagram: positive 85.5%, neutral 7.3%, negative 7.2%.
- youtube: positive 63.6%, neutral 21.1%, negative 15.2%.

## Engagement vs sentiment
- Avg engagement percentile by sentiment: negative 0.492, neutral 0.494, positive 0.508 (spread 0.016).
- Relationship is essentially flat (sentiment does not predict engagement).

## Dominant topics (by volume)
- T0: business, time, real, build - 20,616 posts.
- T6: understand, easy, easy understand, simple - 1,934 posts.
- T3: free, free praise, praise, paid - 1,035 posts.
- T5: chat, gpt, chat gpt, voice - 964 posts.
- T1: course, step, complete, completed - 920 posts.

## Emerging vs declining topics (recent vs earlier in window)
- Rising: T5: chat, gpt, chat gpt, voice (+1.17 pts).
- Rising: T4: start, ready, step, scratch (+0.24 pts).
- Rising: T2: clear, wish, understandable, clear understandable (+0.22 pts).
- Declining: T0: business, time, real, build (-0.48 pts).
- Declining: T6: understand, easy, easy understand, simple (-0.95 pts).

## Top keywords (by volume)
- ChatGPT - 5,448 posts.
- AI Agents - 4,105 posts.
- Automation - 3,687 posts.
- Startup - 3,420 posts.
- Digital Marketing - 2,493 posts.

## Models
- Production sentiment model: vader (deploy-domain macro-F1 0.6493).
- Topic model: NMF, k=7, UMass coherence -1.1959 (more coherent than LDA).
